rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: General Notice 1330 of 1999, which supersedes Notice 1151 of 11 June 1999: the President of the Constitutional Court, A. Chaskalson, signing at Johannesburg on 8 June 1999, fixed Monday 14 June 1999 at 10:30, in the Chamber of Parliament, Cape Town, for the nomination and election of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly, and 14:30 for the nomination and election of the President of the Republic.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-09 only. Election, oath, inauguration, resignation announcement, resignation effect and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Deputy presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded.
